messages:
Nora: Quick idea: 'Climb for Lunch' this week? 20-30 min bouldering session at nearby gym after lunch. low commitment, just come when you can. :rock_climbing:
Eli: Ooh yes. which gym? the one by 5th or the new spot on market?
Nora: Market one has better topouts. 12:45 meetup?
Kai: I can make Tues/Thu. I'm terrible at dynos but cheer squad included. :grin:
Zoe: I have a meeting at 1:00 Tue but can swing by for 20 mins. scaled entry is perfect.
Eli: can we do a friendly route-swap challenge? each person picks one route for another to try. winner = stick the landing without chalk explosion.
Nora: love that. low-stakes but fun. also optional prize: homemade banana bread from Zoe (:eyes:)
Zoe: I will neither confirm nor deny bakery powers.
beans-bot: beans-bot: Reminder set for Tue and Thu 12:40pm in #random. To RSVP reply "climb" in thread.
Kai: RSVP: climb (Tue). bringing chalk.
Eli: RSVP: climb (Thu). bringing positive vibes.
Nora: RSVP: climb (Tue & Thu). banana bread pending.
Zoe: RSVP: tentative Tue. will post if fully free.
Eli: PSA: if you want a belay partner text me before, i can borrow a harness.
Nora: Cool. i'll make a tiny checklist in the thread for route-swap picks. see y'all at the wall :sunglasses:
Kai: Also FYI, gym closes at 2:30 so short and sweet.
Zoe: perfect. low-commit, high-grin.
